note: Rustic campground on Ross Lake in the UP near Melstrand, 22 miles northeast of Shingleton via H-15, H-58 and Russ Lake Road (the last ~3 miles a well-maintained dirt road), fewer than 10 miles from Pictured Rocks National Lakeshore. The forested sites are set back from the lake with no direct lake views; steep, narrow footpaths lead down to the water from some sites (one between sites 3 and 4). A boating access site less than 1/4 mile north launches kayaks and canoes. ORVs may ride between the campground and nearby trails, including Trail 8. --Claude
summary: DNR page + SF amenity table: $20, no electric, vault toilets, hand-pump water, first-come only, 15-day max (all confirmed, derived -> manual); 10 sites 'for tents and trailers' (confirmed; no length limit). Season 'open all year' (roads not plowed) already manual, left. Type 'rustic', not equestrian; ORV operation between campground and trails allowed (Trail 8), but it is not described as an ORV trail camp. No road warning on the page. Note: field restatements dropped, and 'official wording cites tent, small-trailer and large-trailer use' replaced by the page's current 'tents and trailers'.
